title.zh: 「不可許」要写成条目：伊犁交涉中的一次说服
title.en: Turning "Not Acceptable" into a List of Clauses: One Act of Persuasion in the Ili Negotiation

dek.zh: 崇厚与俄国定约后，朝议久争不决。左宗棠上奏逐条指出界务、商务两处不可许，给出议论与战阵两步的方案；奏上获嘉许后，他又自请出屯哈密。一份谈砸的协议面前，光说反对不够，还得说清哪几条不能让、以及凭什么再谈。
dek.en: After Chong Hou concluded a treaty with Russia, the court debated it at length without reaching a decision. Zuo Zongtang's memorial put the objection into items — the border terms and the trade terms, each marked as unacceptable — and set out a two-stage plan of negotiation followed by battle. After the memorial was commended, he volunteered to take command at Hami. Faced with a badly negotiated agreement, opposing it is not enough: you have to say which clauses cannot move, and what stands behind your demand to talk again.

heading.en: The Treaty Was Signed; the Debate Would Not End

paras.zh: 俄国此前出兵占了新疆的伊犁；以西事自任、统兵经营新疆的左宗棠请与俄议还伊犁，朝廷诏遣全权大臣崇厚使俄，谈成一份条约。崇厚为朝士所纠，议了很久，议不出结果。作者的一种解释是：难处不在于要不要伊犁，而在于约已经签了；认账，是失地失利权在先；翻案，得有人去谈，还得有让对方重新坐下来的筹码。
paras.en: Russia had earlier sent troops in and seized Ili, in Xinjiang. Zuo Zongtang, who had taken the western affairs upon himself and led the campaign in Xinjiang, asked that the return of Ili be negotiated with Russia, and the court sent Chong Hou, a plenipotentiary envoy, to Russia, where he concluded a treaty. Chong Hou was censured by court officials, and the debate dragged on toward no conclusion. One reading, the author's, is that the trouble was never whether Ili mattered, but that the treaty had already been signed. Accept it, and the lost territory and compromised rights stood as a fait accompli. Repudiate it, and someone had to go back to the table carrying enough leverage to make the other side sit down again.

paras.zh: 僵局之中，以西事自任的左宗棠上奏，逐条点出哪几处不可许，主张「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」。奏上获嘉许，崇厚得罪去，朝廷命曾纪泽使俄改约；他于是自请出屯哈密。六年四月（原文年号纪年），他「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。七月，他奉诏入都备顾问，由西路统兵的锦棠（原文仅作此称，与东路统兵的金顺并非一人）接替。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁。
paras.en: Into that deadlock stepped Zuo Zongtang, who had taken the western affairs upon himself, with a memorial. Item by item he named the terms that must not be accepted, and argued that one should "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory." The throne commended it; Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, and the court sent Zeng Jize to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo then asked leave to move his headquarters to Hami. In the fourth month of the sixth year (by the reign-year count used in the source) he "set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage," and reached Hami in the fifth month. In the seventh month he was summoned to the capital and Jintang (as the source calls him; a different man from Jin Shun, who led the eastern column), who led the western column, took his place. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded and Ili was returned.

paras.zh: 先看这份奏疏落在什么样的局面里。传中所称的「帕夏」，是一位能役使回众的首领，他通使结援英、俄，购买兵械自备；英人暗中相助，想让他别立一国，用以屏障俄国。本文所据材料未录其名，也未写明他与伊犁之事的直接关系；这一句只交代英、俄各自插手的背景。俄方则因回众屡扰其边境，出兵逐回，占了伊犁，还说要代取乌鲁木齐。
paras.en: Start with the situation the memorial landed in. The figure the biography calls the Pasha was a leader who could command the Muslim population; he sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia, and bought weapons to arm his own forces. The British backed him quietly, hoping to see him set up a separate state that would stand as a shield against Russia. The material used here does not give his name or spell out his direct connection to the Ili affair; this line serves only to show how Britain and Russia each had a hand in the region. Russia, for its part, because Muslim raiders repeatedly harassed its border, sent troops to drive them out, seized Ili, and announced that it would go on to take Urumqi on China's behalf.

paras.zh: 其时有伊犁之变，朝廷诏左宗棠分兵屯肃州，他遣徐占彪带六千人前往。传中另记一事：俄方与土耳其交战时，左宗棠部下统兵的金顺请求乘虚袭击伊犁，左宗棠不许，说「不可。師不以正，彼有辭矣」。
paras.en: At the time of the Ili crisis, the court ordered Zuo Zongtang to detach troops to garrison Suzhou, and he sent Xu Zhanbiao with six thousand men. The biography records a separate episode: when Russia was at war with Turkey, Jin Shun, one of the commanders under Zuo, asked to exploit the opening and strike Ili. Zuo refused: "No. If our army does not act from a position of right, we hand them their excuse."

paras.zh: 一种解释是，他宁可错过一次乘虚出兵的机会，也不让对方事后找到说辞。至于他当时怎么权衡，本文所据材料只录了这一句，不作推测。
paras.en: One reading of it is that he would rather let an opening to strike slip by than give the other side a justification to use afterward. As for how he weighed the decision, the material used here gives only this line, and we do not speculate beyond it.

paras.zh: 四年正月，他条上新疆建行省事宜，并请与俄国议两件事：还伊犁、交叛人。朝廷诏遣全权大臣崇厚使俄。
paras.en: In the first month of the fourth year, he submitted a plan for turning Xinjiang into a regular province, and asked the court to negotiate two matters with Russia: the return of Ili, and the surrender of the defectors. The court sent Chong Hou, a plenipotentiary, to Russia.

heading.en: Three Sets of Accounts in the Memorial

paras.zh: 俄方开出通商、分界、偿款三项条件，崇厚在俄定约，动作很快——史书用一个「遽」字：「崇厚遽定約」。约成之后，崇厚为朝士所纠，朝廷议论长久不能决定。条约是签了，崇厚却遭纠劾，议久不决，事情悬在半空。
paras.en: The Russian side laid out three heads of demand: trade, borders, and indemnity. Chong Hou concluded the treaty, and quickly — the history reaches for one blunt word: "Chong Hou hastily concluded the treaty." Chong Hou was then censured by court officials, and the debate went on without decision. The treaty had been signed, yet Chong Hou had been censured and the debate stalled; the whole affair hung in mid-air.

paras.zh: 左宗棠的奏疏先算账。自俄国盘踞伊犁，蚕食不止，新疆有日蹙百里之势；俄国视伊犁为外府，我方一索地，它就索偿卢布五百万元。「是俄還伊犁，於俄無損，我得伊犁，僅一荒郊」。作者的一种解释是：名义上的收复，实利仍在对方手里。数字照史书所录，未经核实。
paras.en: Zuo's memorial opened by doing the arithmetic. Since Russia occupied Ili it had been nibbling away without pause, until Xinjiang looked set to shrink by a hundred li a day. Russia treated Ili as an outer treasury: the moment we asked for the land back, it demanded five million rubles in compensation. "So Russia's return of Ili would cost Russia nothing; what we would get is only a wasteland on the outskirts." One reading, the author's, is that the recovery would be nominal, and the real profit would stay on the other side. The figure is recorded as the history gives it and has not been verified.

paras.zh: 然后是界务。崇厚又议将陬尔果斯河、帖克斯河一带给俄国，等于划伊犁西南之地归俄。奏中说：「武事不競之秋，有割地求和者矣。茲一矢未加，遽捐要地，此界務之不可許者也」——一仗没打，先捐要地，这是不可许的第一条。
paras.en: Next, the border. Chong Hou had further proposed to hand Russia the country around the Chorgos and Tekes rivers, which amounted to cutting away the land southwest of Ili. The memorial pressed the point: "In an age when our arms are not strong, there have been those who carved up territory to buy peace. Here, without a single arrow loosed, we would cast away a vital place — this is the border term that cannot be accepted." Not one battle fought, and the key ground surrendered first.

paras.zh: 第二条是商务。俄商志在贸易，俄国政府广设领事，想「欲藉通商深入腹地」，「此商務之不可許者也」。界务看得见一块地，商务看得见一条往里走的路。
paras.en: The second item was trade. Russian merchants were after commerce, and the Russian government was planting consulates far and wide, meaning to "use trade to penetrate deep into the interior" — "this is the trade term that cannot be accepted." The border clause is a piece of land you can see; the trade clause is a road running inward.

paras.zh: 奏中还点破对方的算计：「臣維俄人包藏禍心，妄忖吾國或厭用兵，遂以全權之使臣牽制疆臣」——俄方妄自揣度我方或厌用兵，便用一位全权使臣把疆臣的手捆住。
paras.en: The memorial also named the calculation on the other side: "I observe that the Russians harbor ill intent, presuming that our country may be weary of war, and so they use a fully empowered envoy to bind the hands of the frontier commander." They had wrongly presumed us tired of fighting, and turned a plenipotentiary into a leash on the man in the field.

paras.zh: 奏中提出的对策是：「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」，末了又说「臣雖衰慵無似，敢不勉旃」。议论与战阵不是二选一，是有先后的两步。
paras.en: The course the memorial proposed was: "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory" — closing with "Though I am old, tired, and of no great ability, how dare I not do my best." Negotiation and battle were not alternatives to choose between; they were two steps in a fixed order.

paras.zh: 奏上，上壮其言，嘉许之，崇厚得罪去，命曾纪泽使俄更前约。于是左宗棠自请出屯哈密，规复伊犁：金顺出精河为东路，张曜沿特克斯河为中路，锦棠经布鲁特游牧为西路，谭上连等分屯喀什噶尔、阿克苏、哈密为后路声援，合马步卒四万余人——原文只记这一合计数，未记实际投入兵力。
paras.en: The memorial went up. The throne found the words stirring and commended them; Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, and Zeng Jize was sent to Russia to revise the earlier treaty. Thereupon Zuo volunteered to take the field at Hami and plan the recovery of Ili: Jin Shun would advance on Jinghe as the eastern column, Zhang Yao along the Tekes as the central column, and Jintang through the Burut grazing lands as the western column, while Tan Shanglian and others garrisoned Kashgar, Aksu, and Hami in support along the line of communications — more than forty thousand cavalry and infantry all told. The source gives only this combined figure and does not record how many troops were actually committed.

paras.zh: 六年四月，左宗棠「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。俄方闻王师大出，增兵守伊犁、纳林河，另派兵船在海上出没，用以震撼京师，天津、奉天、山东同时告警。谈判桌之外，两边都在调动。
paras.en: In the fourth month of the sixth year Zuo set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage, and reached Hami in the fifth. Hearing that the imperial army was moving in force, Russia reinforced Ili and the Nalin River and sent warships cruising off the coast to shake the capital; at the same time Tianjin, Fengtian, and Shandong all raised the alarm. Away from the negotiating table, both sides were moving troops.

paras.zh: 七月，朝廷诏宗棠入都备顾问，以锦棠代之。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁，防海军皆罢。从一道奏疏到一纸和约，中间有曾纪泽使俄改约，也有数次调动、增兵与告警，最后落在文书上。
paras.en: In the seventh month the court summoned Zuo to the capital as an adviser and put Jintang in his place. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded, Ili was handed back, and the coastal defenses were stood down. Between one memorial and one treaty lay Zeng Jize's mission to Russia to revise the treaty, as well as several troop movements, reinforcements, and alarms — and in the end it all came to rest on paper.

paras.zh: 作者推断，这道奏疏的分量来自结构，不只来自立场。它把反对拆成条目——界务一处、商务一处，各自说明为何不可许；把方案写成顺序——先议论、后战阵。随后崇厚得罪去，朝廷命曾纪泽使俄更前约，这一段是有记录的。奏疏获嘉许之后，他又自请出屯哈密，把第二步落到具体的人和地上。
paras.en: The author's reading is that this memorial carried weight through its structure, not merely its stance. It broke the objection into items — one for the border terms, one for trade, each with its own stated reason for refusal. It wrote the plan as a sequence: negotiation first, battle second. That Chong Hou was then punished and dismissed, and Zeng Jize sent to revise the earlier treaty, is on the record. After the memorial was commended, he volunteered to hold Hami, making the second step concrete — a named man in a named place.

paras.zh: 另一层容易被忽略的是钱粮，不过这是更早西征收复新疆时的事。西征之初，左宗棠请借外债，诏拨款五百万、敕自借外国债五百万；史书说，出塞凡二十月，新疆南北城尽复，是馈运饶给之力。一种解释是，此前西征靠馈运饶给成事，提出「堅忍而求勝」时可以此为凭。本文所据材料未记伊犁对峙时的钱粮，不能把两者写成同一时期。
paras.en: The layer easily missed is money and grain — though this belongs to the earlier western expedition that recovered Xinjiang. At the outset of that expedition, Zuo asked to borrow from abroad; the court allotted five million and directed him to raise a further five million as a foreign loan. The history says that in twenty months beyond the passes, the cities of northern and southern Xinjiang were all recovered — and that it was the abundance of supply transport that accomplished it. One reading is that the earlier campaign had succeeded on the strength of its supply, and that this record stood behind the call to be "patient and set on victory." The material used here says nothing about supply during the Ili standoff, so the two should not be treated as the same period.

paras.zh: 至于成败，史书记了和议成、交还伊犁；在此之前另称「俄亦懾我兵威，恐事遂決裂」，但这与和议成只是并置叙述。史书没有记曾纪泽改约的具体内容，也没有把结果归在某一个人名下。把这段读成主战就对、主和就错的教训，超出了材料能说的话。
paras.en: As for success and failure, the history records that peace was concluded and Ili returned; just before that, it says that Russia, too, was awed by our military might and feared an outright rupture, but this is merely set alongside the conclusion of peace. It gives no substance for Zeng Jize's revision of the treaty, and it does not attach the outcome to any one man's name. To read this episode as a lesson that the war party was right and the peace party wrong goes beyond what the material can support.

paras.zh: 一份采购续约送到手上，里面有随行情调价、有最低采购量。内部有两种声音：一边想整包签下，一边想推倒重来。可用的做法是把条款拆开：哪两条不让、哪几条可以换、拿什么换，一条一条写出来——反对写成条目，才有得谈。
paras.en: A procurement renewal lands in your hands, with prices that adjust to the market and a minimum purchase commitment inside it. There are two voices internally: one wants to sign the whole package, the other wants to start over. The usable move is to break the clauses apart: which two are not open to concession, which few can be traded, and what you would take in exchange — written out one line at a time. An objection becomes negotiable only when it is itemized.

paras.zh: 另一件事是让准备被看见。把备选供应商的评估、切换的时间和成本算清楚，摆在内部会议上，必要时让对方也知道；对方知道你真的走得开，条件才可能松动——也可能换不来松动，那就是要付的价。
paras.en: The other thing is to let the preparation be seen. Work up the evaluation of alternative suppliers, and work out the timing and the cost of a switch; put it on the table in internal meetings, and where necessary let the other side see it too. When they know you can genuinely walk away, terms may loosen — or they may not, and that is the price to be paid.

paras.zh: 本文只有一个史源，即《清史稿·左宗棠传》，成书于1928年，所述与当时档案未必一致。奏疏与对话（如「先之以議論」「師不以正」）是史书的记述，未必是逐字原话。英文版引号内的文字是作者对古文的译述。
paras.en: This piece rests on a single source, the biography of Zuo Zongtang in the Draft History of the Qing, compiled in 1928; its account may not match the archives of the time. The memorial and the dialogue — such as "first take the matter up in negotiation" and "our army does not act from a position of right" — are the history's rendering and may not be verbatim. Quoted passages in English are the author's translations of the classical Chinese.

paras.zh: 编年照原文年号，不换算公元年份；数字照录不核：卢布五百万元、马步卒四万余人、出塞二十月。崇厚所定约的完整条款、曾纪泽改约的具体内容、交还伊犁之外还议了什么，原文未载，本文不补写。「俄亦懾我兵威」与「和議成」在原文中是并置叙述，两者是否因果，未经证实。
paras.en: Dates follow the reign years of the original and are not converted to Western years; figures are copied as given and not checked: five million rubles, more than forty thousand cavalry and infantry, twenty months beyond the passes. The full terms of Chong Hou's treaty, the substance of Zeng Jize's revision, and what else was negotiated besides the return of Ili are not in the source, and this piece does not fill them in. That "Russia was awed by our military might" and that "peace was concluded" appear side by side in the source; whether one caused the other is unproven.

scenario.zh: 一份由被授权人谈成、条件明显不利的合作协议摆在桌上，内部意见不一、久议不决：有人主张认账止损，有人主张全部推翻。
scenario.en: A cooperation agreement negotiated by a duly authorized party — on plainly unfavorable terms — is on the table. Internally, opinion is split and the discussion has stalled: some say accept it and cut your losses, others say throw it out entirely.

question.zh: 你会先认账止损，还是先分清哪几条不可让、再让对方看到你有可信的替代方案和承担代价的准备？
question.en: Would you accept the deal and cut your losses first, or first settle which clauses cannot be conceded, and then show the other side you have a credible alternative and the readiness to bear the cost?

assumptions.zh: 假设协议尚未执行、仍有重谈余地；假设你方能承受一段时间的成本；假设对方在意长期往来而非一次便宜。
assumptions.en: Assume the agreement is not yet being carried out and there is still room to renegotiate; assume your side can absorb a stretch of cost; assume the other party cares about the long-term relationship rather than a single one-off advantage.

steps.zh: 一、把条款拆成条目，标出不可许、可让、可换；二、为每条不可许准备替代方案与代价清单，把承担代价的能力做实；三、按先议论、后行动的顺序推进，让对方看得见你的准备。
steps.en: One: break the terms into individual clauses, marking what is unacceptable, what can be conceded, and what can be traded. Two: for every unacceptable clause, prepare an alternative and a cost sheet, and make your capacity to bear that cost real. Three: move in the order of negotiation first and action second, so that the other side can see your preparation.

alternative.zh: 另一种做法是作者提出的：认账止损，但争取缩短期限、加复议点或对等条款。历史原文没有记下这类权衡，这里只是作者给的备选。
alternative.en: The other approach, the one the author suggests, is to accept the deal and cut losses while pressing for a shorter term, review points, or reciprocal clauses. The historical source records no such weighing; this is simply the alternative the author offers.

uncertainty_note.zh: 本文只据《清史稿·左宗棠传》一个史源，成书于1928年，所述与当时档案未必一致；奏疏与对话是史书记述，未必逐字。编年照原文年号，数字照录不核；「俄亦懾我兵威」与「和議成」是并置叙述，因果未经证实；崇厚约文与曾纪泽改约内容原文未载，不作补写。
uncertainty_note.en: This piece relies on a single source, the biography of Zuo Zongtang in the Draft History of the Qing, compiled in 1928, and its account may not match the archives of the time. The memorial and the dialogue are the history's renderings and may not be verbatim. Dates follow the original reign years; figures are copied as given and not checked. That "Russia was awed by our military might" and that "peace was concluded" appear side by side in the source, and the causal link is unproven. Chong Hou's treaty text and the substance of Zeng Jize's revision are not in the source and are not filled in here.

preheader.zh: 一纸已定之约，一份被听进去的奏疏：先说理、后备阵，改约是怎么谈成的。
preheader.en: A treaty already signed, a memorial that changed it: talk first, and back the talk with force.

sources.citation: 趙爾巽等《清史稿·左宗棠傳》（1928，维基文库本）

further_reading.title: 趙爾巽等《清史稿·左宗棠傳》（1928，维基文库本）

what.en: The source this piece is based on.

episode.action: 在崇厚已与俄国定约、廷议不决时，左宗棠上奏指明界务、商务两条不可许，主张先之以议论、次决之以战阵，并自请出屯哈密以兵势支撑改约。

length.basis: body + question + example; excludes sources and read-more
